newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria tenders for 100,000 tonnes wheat.
newsitem.headline: Algeria tenders for 100,000 tonnes wheat.

text.p: Algeria on Monday launched two snap tenders for the purchase of a total of 100,000 tonnes of U.S. and French soft wheat for shipment in November and December, European traders said.
It invited traders to submit offers on Monday, valid until Thursday, to supply 50,000 tonnes of wheat in second-half November and the rest in first-half December, they said.
Traders said they had been asked to offer both U.S. and French wheat.
Traders said 239,000 tonnes of grain (any type) remained open for Algeria under French Coface-backed export credits.
